goal: Generate an urban landscape image reflecting the leisurely lifestyle and historical layers of Chengdu, suitable as the main image for travel-related activities and events.
style: Fresh watercolor + partial pencil line draft, main colors bamboo green, teacup rice white, brick red and misty gray sky

title_section.title_text: The city in the alley and the covered bowl
title_section.subtitle: Encounter a Sense of Relaxation at the Bend of Jinjiang

geography_skeleton.rivers_or_lakes: The Jinjiang River forms an S-shaped soft line passing from northwest to southeast across the image, with a section of the Funan River and a lake softly blending into light indigo
geography_skeleton.mountains: the western edge of Longmen Mountain and snow peaked hinted with a light purple-gray band
geography_skeleton.main_streets: Chunxi Road—Hongxing Road, Renmin South Road and First Ring Road overlapping in inaccurate light gray squares on the flat land

landmarks.items: The outline of Kuanzhai Alley courtyard, Qingyang Palace Bagua Pavilion, Wuhou Shrine red wall bamboo shadows, Wangjiang Tower and bamboo forest, Dongjiao Memory red brick water tower, 339 TV tower, Global Center arc simplification, Chunxi Road IFS climbing panda, Jiuyan Bridge night lamp arc, Renmin Park crane-ming teahouse and lake surface

centerpiece: Center of the screen slightly below with a combination of a small dragon boat at the bend of Jinjiang River and a tent pavilion at People's Park, with a cartoon panda lying on the city name title, holding a covered bowl
edge_decorations: Lower left corner a dish of red oil wontons and a dish of bell dumplings line drawing
Top right corner ginkgo leaves intertwined with Erjing Tiao small chili peppers
Small seal script red text 'Young people should not enter Sichuan' stamp (decorative, not strong copy)
extras: Footnote: Chengdu is a puzzle on the plain, water and roads determine the direction of relaxation.

must_keep: The great bend of the Jinjiang River forms the dominant visual curve in the image
Proportions of historical districts and modern landmarks are harmonious
Overall, the hand-drawn style is consistent and not a satellite image.
avoid: Misdraw the mountainous terrain of Chongqing on the map of Chengdu
Landmarks Too Dense Like a Station Diagram
Panda ratio overshadows city names and rivers
